title: 第16章 陨石雨第17章 各家老祖出关
content_zh:
“啧啧啧，没想到晖煌也在，年轻一代他可比那陆啸强多了。对了最近几年晖家没什么动静嘛？”闹剧结束，邪帝与冰帝也离开了现场。
“三年前，你登门晖家，五个老祖被你杀三个，他们哪还敢有什么动静啊？”
“谁让他们觊觎你，还是太仁慈了啊，不然五个我一个都不留。”邪帝哼了一声。
“快看，那是什么！”人群中有人惊呼，指向空中。
“那好像是陨石！”
“就是陨石！要落下来！快跑啊！”
邪帝冰帝朝天上望去，只见一颗巨大的陨石正在迅速往下落。
“邪帝！”
“明白。”邪帝张开战神之翼向空中飞去。
“九龙齐出啸天地！”邪帝背后九龙背脊现，九道龙影一起轰向陨石。
“九龙背脊！是邪帝大人！”陨石顷刻间炸裂，无数的碎屑向地面上砸去。
邪帝以极快的速度冲到冰帝面前，用翅膀包裹住冰帝，碎屑砸在了邪帝的背后，肉身硬抗。
“邪帝，没事吧。”
“问题不大。”
“怎么会有陨石？”
“不止有一个，好像还是陨石雨。”冰帝看向天空。
“什么？”邪帝望去，遥远的天空中，落下无数火星，正在慢慢变大，黑夜彻底被点亮。
“主人。老大。”
“邪帝大人，老大。”四女仆赶来。
“这是陨石雨啊！”猫女叫道。

“极光保护好老大去九天圣殿，猫女琉璃你们去梳理人群撤退，神君他们应该也马上会来。影儿我们上！”
“是！”
“邪帝注意安全。”邪帝点了点头。魅影化为灵魂体进入邪帝心中。
“影儿，我们上。粒子战神！”邪帝的身体像是被格式化了一般，随手一挥，无数的黑粒子聚在邪帝周围。
当年魅影便是黑粒子的形态，被称为暗物质，曾一度要将太阳所吞没，引发了宇宙各种灾难，那一天民不聊生，那一天邪帝孤身一人，那一天他回应全宇宙的期望。
邪帝操控着黑粒子，统统组成了巨掌的形态，邪帝想要靠黑粒子去接住陨石。一颗颗陨石落下，黑粒子上前抵挡，但很快被冲散，可又迅速凝聚在一起，不断的抵消着陨石落下的冲击力，使落地时造成的伤害最小。
邪帝悬浮在空中，手不断的挥舞，这样子对邪帝的精神力消耗极大。
“恶魔将军！黑暗龙！”邪帝召唤出座下的18位恶魔将军，以及他的天级神境巅峰灵兽——黑暗龙，“阻止陨石，阿不，保护百姓送他们去避难所，拉上你们的军队，搞快点，这里我还能撑一会，特么的，神君怎么还没来woc！”
18位恶魔将军刚出现便看见了事情的严重性，立马照办，黑暗龙则协助着邪帝。
“邪帝，我们来了。”光暗双芒一闪，圣君至，数颗陨石被劈成四块。
“圣天贯日！”四箭至，陨石灭。
“战龙火炎啸！”“暴风传奇！”风火龙卷，产生的高温竟然直接将陨石融化！炎君女帝道。
content_en:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, I didn't expect Hui Huang to be here. The younger generation is much better than Lu Xiao. By the way, there hasn't been much movement in the Hui family in recent years?" The farce ended, and the Evil Emperor and the Ice Emperor also left the scene.
"Three years ago, when you visited Menhui's family, you killed three of the five ancestors. How dare they make any move?"
"It's too merciful to let them covet you, otherwise I wouldn't keep any of the five." The Evil Emperor snorted.
"Look, what is that!" someone in the crowd exclaimed, pointing to the air.
"That looks like a meteorite!"
"It's a meteorite! It's going to fall! Run!"
The Evil Emperor Ice Emperor looked up into the sky and saw a huge meteorite falling rapidly.
"Evil Emperor!"
"Understood." The Evil Emperor opened his wings of the God of War and flew into the air.
"Nine dragons roar out of the world together!" The nine dragons' backs appeared behind the evil emperor, and nine dragon shadows blasted towards the meteorite together.
"The back of Nine Dragons! It's Lord Evil Emperor!" The meteorite exploded instantly, and countless debris hit the ground.
The Evil Emperor rushed in front of the Ice Emperor at an extremely fast speed and wrapped his wings around the Ice Emperor. Debris hit the Evil Emperor's back, and he resisted with his physical body.
"Evil Emperor, are you okay?"
"It's not a big problem."
"Why are there meteorites?"
"There's more than one, it seems to be a meteor shower." The Ice Emperor looked at the sky.
"What?" The Evil Emperor looked and saw countless sparks falling in the distant sky. They were slowly getting bigger and the night was completely lit up.
"Master. Boss."
"Master Evil Emperor, boss." Four maids came over.
"This is a rain of meteorites!" Catwoman shouted.
"Aurora protects the boss and goes to the Nine Heavens Temple. Catwoman Liuli and you go sort out the crowd and retreat. Shenjun and the others should be coming soon. Ying'er, let's go!"
"Yes!"
"Evil Emperor, please be safe." Evil Emperor nodded. The phantom transformed into a soul body and entered the heart of the Evil Emperor.
"Ying'er, let's go. Particle War God!" The evil emperor's body seemed to be formatted. With a wave of his hand, countless black particles gathered around the evil emperor.
Back then, the Phantom was in the form of black particles, known as dark matter. It once threatened to engulf the sun, causing various disasters in the universe. On that day, people were in dire straits, on that day the Evil Emperor was alone, on that day he responded to the expectations of the entire universe.
The Evil Emperor controlled the black particles and all formed the shape of a giant palm. The Evil Emperor wanted to use the black particles to catch the meteorite. Meteorites fell one after another, and the black particles stepped forward to resist, but were quickly scattered, but quickly condensed together, constantly offsetting the impact of the falling meteorites, minimizing the damage caused when they landed.
The Evil Emperor is suspended in the air, waving his hands constantly, which consumes a lot of the Evil Emperor's mental power.
"Devil General! Dark Dragon!" The Evil Emperor summoned the 18 demon generals under his seat, as well as his peak divine beast, the Dark Dragon, "Stop the meteorite, ah no, protect the people and send them to the shelter, pull up your army, hurry up, I can survive here for a while, damn, why hasn't the Divine Lord come to WOC yet!"
The 18 demon generals saw the seriousness of the matter as soon as they appeared and immediately followed the instructions, while the dark dragon assisted the evil emperor.
"Evil Emperor, we are here." There was a flash of light and darkness, the Holy Lord arrived, and several meteorites were split into four pieces.
"The holy sky penetrates the sun!" Four arrows arrived, and the meteorite was destroyed.
"War Dragon Flame Roar!" "Legend of Storm!" Wind and fire tornado, the high temperature generated actually melted the meteorite directly! Empress Yanjun said.
